digest.component_or_area: bridge reconciliation runner and CI workflow wrapper
propositions: Extract production bridge wrapper logic into a single runner-neutral Python entrypoint that accepts legacy MODE vocabulary and maps all five existing modes to their canonical or legacy routes while preserving backward compatibility.

The runner must translate benign legacy result codes 3/4/75 to provider result 0, preserve operational result 1 and invalid-invocation result 2, and exit 0 on valid BRIDGE_PAUSED marker without delivery.

The runner must validate required environment variables (identity, run id) before reconciliation and invoke strict ticket-store delivery with complete command contract including BRIDGE_RUN_ID in commit message on successful non-paused passes.

Retain provider-specific workflows (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab) with only native checkout, credentials, artifacts, scheduling, and result mapping while delegating reconciliation and delivery logic to the shared runner.

Vendor GitLab Draft-07 CI schema at immutable commit 776c20ad with verified provenance, checksum, and offline validation; pin shellcheck-py==0.11.0.1 and validate all extracted shell bodies without skips.

Establish five-environment matrix tests and retain all existing workflow parsing, lint, policy, and partial-clone tests to prove identical runner behavior and maintain compatibility with legacy reconcile callers.
